title: Docs: wording and a corrected default in the configuration page

notes.what: Two wording fixes in the configuration page and the documented default for remember_passes_hours corrected from 12 to 24, which is what the code does.
notes.why: A reader opened an issue because the page said 12 hours and the tool remembered for 24.
notes.edge: None in code. The only way this is wrong is if the code default changes again without the page.
notes.risk: No runtime effect. The docs build is strict, so a broken link would have failed the build; none were touched.
notes.test: Build the docs locally and read the page; grep the source for the default to confirm 24.
